# TC-CLI-312 错误码矩阵（契约 §4）：每个可由 CLI 触发的错误码至少一例，断言退出码与
# 最后一行 error 事件。E_USAGE 的参数类用例见 TC-CLI-2xx；E_CANCELLED 需要信号，
# 见 backend/e2e TC-E2E-101/102；E_INTERNAL 是未分类错误的兜底，无法由合法输入触发。

exec databackup --json backup --source $WORK/src --repo $WORK/repo --name ok
stdin pw.txt
exec databackup --json backup --source $WORK/src --repo $WORK/repo --name enc --encrypt aes256 --password-stdin
cp junk.txt $WORK/repo/bad.dbk

# ---- 退出码 1 ----
# E_NOT_FOUND：源目录 / restore / info / delete 的备份不存在
exec expect 1 --json backup --source $WORK/missing --repo $WORK/repo
stdout '"code":"E_NOT_FOUND"'
exec expect 1 --json restore --backup missing --repo $WORK/repo --target $WORK/t1
stdout '"code":"E_NOT_FOUND"'
exec expect 1 --json info missing --repo $WORK/repo
stdout '"code":"E_NOT_FOUND"'
exec expect 1 --json delete $WORK/repo/missing.dbk
stdout '"code":"E_NOT_FOUND"'

# E_EXISTS
exec expect 1 --json backup --source $WORK/src --repo $WORK/repo --name ok
stdout '"code":"E_EXISTS"'

# E_TARGET_NOT_EMPTY：非空目录 / 不是目录
exec expect 1 --json restore --backup ok --repo $WORK/repo --target $WORK/src
stdout '"code":"E_TARGET_NOT_EMPTY"'
exec expect 1 --json restore --backup ok --repo $WORK/repo --target $WORK/junk.txt
stdout '"code":"E_TARGET_NOT_EMPTY"'

# E_CORRUPT：restore / info 损坏的备份
exec expect 1 --json restore --backup bad --repo $WORK/repo --target $WORK/t2
stdout '"code":"E_CORRUPT"'
exec expect 1 --json info bad --repo $WORK/repo
stdout '"code":"E_CORRUPT"'

# E_IO：仓库路径是普通文件
exec expect 1 --json backup --source $WORK/src --repo $WORK/junk.txt --name x
stdout '"code":"E_IO"'

# ---- 退出码 2 ----
exec expect 2 --json backup --source $WORK/junk.txt --repo $WORK/repo
stdout '"code":"E_USAGE"'
exec expect 2 --json backup --source $WORK/src --repo $WORK/src
stdout '"code":"E_USAGE","message":"仓库目录不能是源目录本身"'
exec expect 2 --json delete $WORK/repo/ok.txt
stdout '"code":"E_USAGE"'
exec expect 2 --json backup --source $WORK/src --repo $WORK/repo --name ''
stdout '"code":"E_USAGE"'

# ---- 退出码 3 ----
stdin bad-pw.txt
exec expect 3 --json restore --backup enc --repo $WORK/repo --target $WORK/t3 --password-stdin
stdout '"code":"E_AUTH"'
exec expect 3 --json restore --backup enc --repo $WORK/repo --target $WORK/t3
stdout '"code":"E_PASSWORD_REQUIRED"'
! exists $WORK/t1
! exists $WORK/t2
! exists $WORK/t3

-- pw.txt --
right
-- bad-pw.txt --
wrong
-- junk.txt --
junk
-- src/a.txt --
a
